newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares unmoved by Monday's election news.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares unmoved by Monday's election news.

text.p: Singapore shares slipped back slightly at Monday's close, unmoved by news late in the trading day that the country would state general elections on January 2.
"I think any firm reaction lasted about 10 minutes," one dealer told Reuters.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index ended the day almost unchanged at 2,195.86, down just 0.95 points, while the Business Times-Singapore Regional Index dipped 0.91 to 1,086.41.
Election news was the main feature of a quiet day which many in the market saw as an early start to seasonal festivities.
"I spent the morning phoning people to wish them merry Christmas -- it was the most productive I've been today," said one dealer with a local firm.
Volume of just 57.3 million shares traded reflected the relaxed mood of the market, producing 222 losers to 82 gainers on pre-Christmas profit-taking.

Cycle & Carriage led gainers, up Singapore $0.30 to S$16.80, followed by Singapore Press's domestic tranche up S$0.20 at S$13.20. Creative Technology was the firm loser, down S$0.80 to S$12.70, while Singapore Press's foreign tranche dropped S$0.20 to S$26.90.
